{{one source |date=April 2024}}
In mathematics, the '''Kantor double''' is a [[Jordan superalgebra]] structure on the sum of two copies of a [[Poisson algebra]]. It is named after [[Isaiah Kantor]], who introduced it in 1990.<ref>{{Cite book |title=Proceedings of the Annual Seminar of the Canadian Mathematical Society on Lie Theory, Differential Equations and Representation Theory |date=1990 |isbn=978-2-921120-03-6 |editor-last=Hussin |editor-first=Véronique |location=Montréal |editor-last2=Canadian Mathematical Society |editor-last3=Université de Montréal}}</ref>
